dedupe_keys.name: malaysia rainfall and kalumpang terrain interpolation data

description: Rainfall-and-Kalumpang-Malaysia publishes rainfall observations and terrain data for testing scattered-data interpolation. The repository distinguishes rainfall folders, a 2024 rainfall folder and Kalumpang terrain files. Its linked Zenodo v1.0 deposit is freely available under CC BY 4.0. The article describes Malaysian station observations and a Selangor agricultural-station terrain sample, but the repository metadata does not establish a single observation period, spatial accuracy or internal file format for the archive. The publisher’s displayed station latitude is inconsistent with the stated Malaysian location; no corrected coordinate is inferred here. Users must inspect the data documentation before mapping stations or treating interpolated surfaces as measured values. A reviewer-assessed use is checking rainfall or terrain interpolation used to prepare stormwater and agricultural exposure inputs. model-openfoam is a related flow-modelling resource, with no ready-made input conversion claimed. The earlier candidate rejection arose from a digital-infrastructure search; this reusable water-and-land dataset belongs within the broader review scope.
name: Malaysia rainfall and Kalumpang terrain interpolation data
notes: G2 G2-0038. Metadata-only review. Simulation uses and cross-resource relations are reviewer assessments. No data or archive downloaded and no simulation run.
